news.headline: From Security to Service: How GovRAMP Membership Shapes Bentek’s Public Sector Impact
Bentek Named Benefits Administration Platform of the Year by Gov CIO Outlook
Bentek Named to Inc.’s 2026 Best Workplaces List

paragraphs: Bentek sells benefits administration software purpose-built for the public sector. The company describes it as designed exclusively for states, local governments and educational institutions. It says its focus is the benefits administration needs of schools, counties and city governments.

The platform is put to work through configurable workflows, automated processes and adaptable reporting tools. It integrates with HRIS and payroll systems so data moves between platforms with less manual entry. Bentek says the platform carries more than 5,000 business rules. A library of more than 60 ready-made reports covers enrollment, engagement and compliance. Self-service enrollment handles active employees, retirees and COBRA participants.

Bentek says it was founded to serve public sector organizations. The company says its story began in 2006. It started when a local school district struggled to manage its benefits. The company puts its experience in the public sector environment at more than 20 years. It says it serves more than 300 employers in the public sector. One story on the site describes helping the Government of the U.S. Virgin Islands transform its benefits administration in four months.
